# Vendored browser libraries

Copied unmodified from npm, served from here so the map and scanner work without third-party CDNs.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz (`dist/`) | BSD-2-Clause, `leaflet/LICENSE` |
| Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated | 0.2.1 | https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet-imageoverlay-rotated/-/leaflet-imageoverlay-rotated-0.2.1.tgz | Beerware, `leaflet-imageoverlay-rotated/LICENSE` |
| jsQR | 1.4.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js (QR decoding where the browser lacks `BarcodeDetector`, e.g. iOS) | Apache-2.0, `jsqr/LICENSE` |

Upgrade by replacing the files from the newer package and updating this table.
